verdict.rationale: Crossplane documents its own 'Environment Configs' feature, described as 'in-memory data stores for Compositions', which can supply environment-specific data to compositions. Nothing in the evidence shows separate stacks or workspaces for dev, staging and prod, or a documented per-environment workflow, so only a thin, glancing match is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented per-environment stack/workspace separation, examples of dev/staging/prod configuration management, detail on how Environment Configs are selected per environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
